releaseNotes:
🚀 3.6 Update!

- NEW: Fix Gyro Delay (free). It resets the sensors, turns off battery saver and measures your gyroscope's real update rate, so you can see if the aim lag comes from your phone or from the game
- Custom DNS: added AdGuard and CleanBrowsing Family
- Real-time Hardware Monitor: new Storage and Network speed meters
- Custom Screen Resolution: type your own DPI (Direct change and Floating menu) when Auto calculate DPI is off
